request:
Implement m3a-002 in this real Tokage repository: reduce redundant scroll-observer lifecycle work in SessionHistoryView while preserving the m3a-001 reading behavior. Current scroll effect depends on visibleLogs (fresh snapshots and transcriptRows arrays), recreating ResizeObserver on each render/update. Meet the preregistered acceptance below. Add meaningful rendered React/happy-dom tests; keep all existing tests, do not weaken assertions or change build configuration. Do not edit files outside write_scope, even transiently. Do not edit .tokage, reliability docs, runner, model/auth/DB or package files. Use the already installed dev dependencies. Run npm ci --ignore-scripts --offline --no-audit --no-fund, npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run check:i18n and npm run build. Native sandbox only permits workspace writes: create ignored src-tauri/target/m3a-tmp and set TMPDIR="$PWD/src-tauri/target/m3a-tmp" for test/build commands. Do not write HOME or system temp. Tokage records delivery commits; do not commit yourself. Report under the required TaskReport headings, deviations None if none. External desktop streaming validation is performed independently after delivery; do not claim it already passed.

Preregistered acceptance:
For one selected attempt, at least 100 successive rendered transcript updates create at most one ResizeObserver subscription; content growth is still observed. Measure construction/disconnection counts in a rendered DOM test, not just a helper mock.
Selection change and unmount disconnect obsolete observers; queued callbacks after cleanup cannot scroll or alter the newly selected attempt. Cover cleanup and stale callbacks with DOM tests.
Preserve initial latest position, bottom following, scrolled-up reading position, keyboard-accessible return-to-latest, attempt reset, empty/loading/error/end behavior, and message spacing. Keep all m3a-001 regressions passing.
Typecheck, all frontend tests, i18n validation and production build pass. No runtime dependencies, package/build configuration, auth, database or model routing changes.
Independent review before desktop merge. Build delivered source and repeat real GPT6 Luna stream geometry plus durable DONE validation. This requirement counts once, preserving any failures or external rescue.
